# uptimekuma_notification_lunasea (Resource)

Lunasea notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_lunasea" "user_target" {
  name            = "Lunasea User Notifications"
  target          = "user"
  lunasea_user_id = "YOUR_LUNASEA_USER_ID"
  is_default      = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_lunasea" "device_target" {
  name       = "Lunasea Device Notifications"
  target     = "device"
  device     = "YOUR_LUNASEA_DEVICE_ID"
  is_default = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name
- `target` (String) Target type: "user" or "device"

### Optional

- `apply_existing` (Boolean) Attach this notification to all existing monitors. This is a one-time action: it runs when the notification is created with `true`, or when the value changes from `false` to `true`. Other updates do not attach it again, so monitors detached from the notification later stay detached. Uptime Kuma does not store the value, so the provider keeps it from the configuration. An imported notification starts with `false`.
- `device` (String, Sensitive) Lunasea device ID (required when target is "device")
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `lunasea_user_id` (String, Sensitive) Lunasea user ID (required when target is "user")

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
